name: v1.5.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Add uninstall target to the makefile by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/66
* Update README.md by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/76
* Fix AppImage image by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/77
* Also set the icon for the settings window by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/78
* Fix arm64 builds by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/86
* Fix crash when setting keybind by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/85
* Remember all options after restart and add button to reset in settings by @koutoftimer in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/81
* g_idle_add with `return FALSE` instead of ...add_once by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/87

name: v1.4.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Fix badge link by @svemat01 in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/30
* Format code by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/34
* Move web/ to its own repository by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/36
* Add "All repositories" header by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/37
* Create assets/ folder by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/39
* Change default millisecond value from 10 to 100 by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/42
* Introduce hold mode that is running while hotkey is held down by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/41
* Fix unmatched interval notice in settings UI by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/43
* Implement "hold time per click" option by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/45
* Load from config path from glib function by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/46
* Delete .gitattributes by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/47
* Fix github link in settings by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/48
* Update readme to reflect new functions by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/49
* Update image in Readme  by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/50
* Version 1.4.0 by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/51
* Make parameters match prototype by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/52
* Update package build-essential by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/53
* Update gcc to gcc-11 by @robiot in https://github.com/robiot/xclicker/pull/54
